title: Setup: Health
body: Prerequisites: Companies, Admin users, Party, Product; Stock for pharmacy; Financial if charging. Steps: institution /settings; patients; appointments; lab; pharmacy/medications; beds. Impacts: clinical ops; may drive service invoices. Does not replace CoA. Claims e-submit is gap G-14 (needs confirmation). Related: wf-admit, wf-book-appointment, wf-lab-results, wf-dispense.
